sentences.text: In the meantime, the order dated dated 01-12-2017 passed by learned SDJM, Patna in Complaint Case No. 2620C of 2017, whereby cognizance of offence under Section 498A of the IPC read with Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act has been taken, shall remain stayed.

5. The learned counsel for the petitioners draws the attention of the court to Annexure-4 to the quashing application to submit that the petitioner No. 1 herein, who is the husband, had earlier filed Cr. Misc No. 61196 of 2019, seeking anticipatory bail in which the OP No. 2 herein had appeared and the parties had agreed to resolve the dispute by way of one time settlement and the petitioner was ready to pay an amount of Rs. 15 lakhs.
6. Accordingly, the learned Coordinate Bench was pleased to grant provisional bail to the petitioner No. 1 in Cr. Misc No. 61196 of 2019.

Thereafter, the petitioner No. 1 submitted a demand draft of Rs.
7,50,000/- in the court of learned SDJM, but then the same was not accepted by the OP No. 2 herein
, as such, the petitioner No. 1 filed Cr. Misc No. 27561 of 2023 seeking modification of the order passed in Cr. Misc No. 61196 of 2019.

7. The learned counsel next submits that Cr. Misc No. Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.57165 of 2023(2) dt.15-12-2023 27561 of 2023 was taken up on 26-4-2023, in which the learned Coordinate Bench had directed the OP No. 2 herein to file a show-cause that as to why a contempt proceeding be not initiated against her for violating the undertaking given to this court and at the same time had allowed the petitioner No. 1 herein to withdraw the amount of Rs. 7,50,000/- which was deposited in the court of learned SDJM, Patna.

sentences.text: The learned counsel thus submits that this amply demonstrates that the OP No. 2 is not interested in one-time settlement rather intends to harass her husband and his relatives.
